pairs.description: St. John's wort potently induces CYP3A4 and P-glycoprotein, drastically lowering cyclosporine blood concentrations and triggering acute allograft rejection.
pairs.mechanism: Hyperforin activates the Pregnane X Receptor (PXR), profoundly upregulating intestinal and hepatic CYP3A4 and MDR1/P-gp expression.

pairs.description: St. John's wort induces CYP3A4-mediated clearance of indinavir, dropping plasma drug concentrations below therapeutic levels and risking viral resistance.
pairs.mechanism: Enzymatic induction of cytochrome P450 3A4 and P-glycoprotein transport systems reducing bioavailability.

pairs.description: St. John's wort accelerates metabolic breakdown of ethinyl estradiol and progestins, causing breakthrough bleeding and unintended pregnancy.
pairs.mechanism: Induction of hepatic CYP3A4 enzymes responsible for oxidative estrogen and progestin metabolism.

pairs.description: St. John's wort decreases plasma concentrations of warfarin, resulting in subtherapeutic INR measurements and heightened thromboembolism risk.
pairs.mechanism: Dual induction of hepatic CYP2C9 and CYP3A4 enzymes accelerating the oxidative clearance of warfarin isomers.

pairs.description: Combining St. John's wort with SSRI antidepressants like sertraline creates a life-threatening risk of serotonin syndrome.
pairs.mechanism: Additive inhibition of serotonin reuptake leading to hyperstimulation of central 5-HT1A and 5-HT2A receptors.
